supports.question: Are both the mug and the headphones visible enough to compare their positions?
supports.criteria: Pass if the mug and headphones are identifiable and their relative positions can be judged; fail if the image clearly shows either is absent or the comparison is impossible; unknown if visibility or identification is inconclusive.
supports.binding: Use only the image to identify the mug and headphones and assess whether their relative placement is observable. This establishes evidence availability, not fulfillment.

supports.question: Is the mug positioned to the right of the headphones?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows the mug positioned to the right of the headphones; fail if it clearly shows the mug is not to their right; unknown if their relative position cannot be determined. For R1, complete if this check passes; absent if it fails and no requested change has progressed; partial if the mug has moved toward the requested position but is not yet to the right; unknown if required evidence remains unresolved. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
supports.binding: Compare the mug’s visible position with the headphones in the image. Judge the requested spatial relationship, without requiring a particular editing technique.

specification.fulfillment_criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1 only. Complete (yes) if the mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. Absent (no) only if there is clear evidence that no requested change has progressed. Partial if there is evidence of some progress toward moving the mug to the right of the headphones but the requested relationship is not complete. Unknown if required evidence is insufficient or unresolved; do not infer completion, absence, or progress from unrelated edits.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.
